verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a catalog of auditor-vetted native integrations that collect compliance data automatically and feed evidence requests and continuous monitors. Connected cloud systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP are named explicitly. The evidence does not show coverage of identity, HR, code hosting, MDM or ticketing tools, and says nothing about read-only permission scopes. Missing for 10: evidence of identity/HR/code-hosting/MDM/ticketing integrations, documented read-only scopes per integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
